**Testing checklist**
**Please test the following on production:**

***1\. Referral code validation***
\- Try an invalid code (*e.g., "5" when only 1-2 NFTs exist*) — should show invalid message
\- Try a valid code (*e.g., "1" if NFT #1 exists*) — should show a valid message
\- Try no code — should show "No/Invalid referral code" message

***2\. Minting***
\- Attempt a mint with USDC — should work
\- Check dashboard — only successful mints should appear

***3\. NFT detail page***
\- View an NFT detail page — book cover should display fully
\- As an owner, the "*View Book*" button should be visible

\- Check dashboard badges section — should show 8 badges (Legend removed). Remember badges display is responsive, so the screen size determines it
